meta.name: wowerpoint
meta.description: Turn one document into a kawaii NotebookLM slide-deck PDF. Use for "wowerpoint this", "make a deck about <file>", "turn this report into slides", or any request to render a single document as shareable narrative slides.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文档一键变成可爱风演示文稿 PDF
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常要把报告或文档快速变成可分享的演示文稿
copy.tagline_en: Turn a document into a cute presentation PDF
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn reports or documents into shareable presentations

howto.what: 给 Claude 一份文档,它会用 NotebookLM 生成 kawaii 风格幻灯片 PDF;若配置了服务器环境变量,还会上传换成手机可看的分享链接。生成约十分钟,在后台跑,不阻塞对话。
howto.when: 当你说“Wowerpoint <文件>”、“把这份报告做成幻灯片”等,或要求把单个文档渲染成可分享的叙事幻灯片时触发。

say.text: 把这个文件做成幻灯片
say.note: 约十分钟后给出 PDF 或分享链接
先确认 NotebookLM 已登录

howto.what_en: Given one document, Claude generates a kawaii-style NotebookLM slide-deck PDF and, if the server env vars are set, uploads it to return a mobile share link. Generation takes about 10 minutes and runs in the background.
howto.when_en: Triggers on phrases like "Wowerpoint <file>", "make a slide deck about <file>", or any request to render a single document as shareable narrative slides.

say_en.text: Make a slide deck about this file
say_en.note: PDF or share link in ~10 minutes
NotebookLM must be logged in first
